faq.headline: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subheadline: Everything you need to know about working with The Crock Spot

items.question: What makes The Crock Spot different from other caterers?
items.answer: Our food truck advantage means your food is cooked fresh on-site and never has to be bagged, boxed, or reheated. Plus, our quick-serve concept means guests are served in 25 seconds or less! With 15+ years of experience, we bring the full restaurant experience directly to your event.

items.question: What areas do you serve?
items.answer: We serve the entire Denver Metro area, the Front Range from Fort Collins to Colorado Springs, and mountain regions including Vail, Breckenridge, and Aspen. Contact us to discuss your specific location!

items.question: Do you accommodate dietary restrictions?
items.answer: Absolutely! We offer extensive gluten-free, vegetarian, and vegan options. Our build-your-own bowl concept allows guests to customize their meal to their dietary needs. We mark all dietary options clearly on our menus.

items.question: How far in advance should I book?
items.answer: We recommend booking at least 2-4 weeks in advance for corporate events and 3-6 months for weddings. However, we can sometimes accommodate last-minute requests depending on our schedule!

items.question: What is your pricing structure?
items.answer: Our pricing ranges from $14-22 per person depending on the service style. Food truck service starts at $16-18/person, buffet style at $18-20/person, and themed bars (taco, chili, mac & cheese) at $19-22/person. We offer custom quotes for all events.

items.question: Do you provide everything needed for service?
items.answer: Yes! We provide all serving equipment, utensils, plates, and napkins. For food truck service, we bring the entire kitchen on wheels. For buffet service, we set up everything needed for a seamless experience.

items.question: Can you create custom menus?
items.answer: We love creating custom menus! Whether it's a specialty bowl for your wedding or a themed menu for a corporate event, we work with you to design the perfect spread. We pride ourselves on flexibility and creativity.

items.question: What types of events do you cater?
items.answer: We cater everything from corporate lunches and team-building events to weddings, birthday parties, graduations, family reunions, and large festivals. If there's food involved, we can Crock it!
